items.title: 'Law & Order's E.J. Carroll Dies Suddenly at 66 While Traveling to New Job
items.summary:
Law & Order and Boardwalk Empire actor E.J. Carroll died unexpectedly while en route to a voiceover job. He was 66.

Carroll’s manager, Jon Mason , confirmed on Saturday, November 21, that the veteran character actor collapsed on the street in New York City on Thursday, November 19, while on his way to record lines for an upcoming commercial, per Entertainment Weekly .

A cause of death has not been determined. Mason noted that Mason had recently undergone a medical procedure to correct a hernia.

A memorial service will be held in New York City at a later date.

The Most Shocking Celebrity Deaths of All Time: Hayden Panettiere and More 

“When E.J. Carroll performed, it was impossible to take your eyes off him,” Mason said on Saturday. “But his lasting legacy will be the kindness and generosity he showed his friends, fellow performers and even strangers.”

Mason added that Carroll was “as good a human being as it gets.”

Us has reached out to Carroll’s representative for further information but did not hear back at the time of publication.

Carroll made his TV acting debut in 1998 via a guest spot in the original Law & Order . This brief appearance began a longstanding relationship that saw Carroll play at least seven characters across Law & Order and its spinoffs, Criminal Intent and Special Victims Unit .

He appeared in two episodes of acclaimed HBO crime drama Boardwalk Empire as the crooked Sheriff Victor Sickles, in addition to starring in six episodes of porn industry drama The Deuce as shop owner Fat Mooney.

items.t: 'Law & Order's E.J. Carroll Dies Suddenly at 66 While Traveling to New Job

The bride’s former stepdad, Kroy Biermann , was reportedly absent at the Naples, Florida, wedding as he did not receive an invitation. Also absent was Brielle’s half-brother KJ Biermann amid his legal troubles. (Twins Kaia and Kane were reportedly absent as well.)

Months before the ceremony, Brielle was able to enjoy a bachelorette weekend with her closest friends, including sister Ariana.

items.title: John Corbett and Bo Derek Adopted Late Gene Hackman's Dog After His Death
items.summary:
John Corbett and Bo Derek took in the late Gene Hackman and Betsy Arakawa ’s dog Bear following their tragic deaths.

Derek, 70, revealed in a Friday, November 20, The Hollywood Reporter profile that she and Corbett, 65, initially needed convincing to adopt another pup in addition to their two German shepherds. After looking at a photo of Bear, Derek immediately changed her mind.

“I was a goner,” the actress quipped, calling the pup a “perfect gentleman.”

Us confirmed in February 2025 that Hackman and his wife had been found dead inside their New Mexico house. They were 95 and 64, respectively.

How Gene Hackman and Wife Betsy's Surviving Dogs Helped First Responders 

“It is with great sadness that we announce the passing of our father, Gene Hackman and his wife, Betsy. He was loved and admired by millions around the world for his brilliant acting career, but to us he was always just Dad and Grandpa,” the Oscar winner’s daughters and granddaughter said in a statement. “We will miss him sorely and are devastated by the loss.”

Hackman’s cause of death was ultimately ruled as hypertensive atherosclerotic cardiovascular disease with Alzheimer’s disease as a significant contributing factor. He died nearly one week after Arakawa, who died from hantavirus pulmonary syndrome.

Gene Hackman at the 2003 Golden Globes. Robert Mora/Getty Images

items.title: Britney Spears Apologizes to Her Family for 'Bringing Up Past Issues'

Britney Spears is presumably ready to clear the air with her family after a long-held estrangement.

“I’m so blessed to have such a beautiful family,” Spears, 44, wrote via Instagram on Saturday, November 21. “I’m so very sorry for bringing up past issues, but I think I did because I realized I needed to protect my heart.”

Britney is the eldest daughter of exes Jamie Spears and Lynne Spears , who also share son Bryan, 49, and daughter Jamie Lynn, 35.

“It’s the way I love and when I love you, I REALLY love you,” Britney stated on Saturday. “My stubbornness is childish and embarrassing. Thoughts on the past, I’m obviously human and there actually might be something to those things I said phycology [sic] wise, either way I’m sorry to my family bringing up those memories.”

She continued, “I’ve never actually spoke to them face to face on it. It’s frankly [because] I just miss them like crazy!!! And I’m very sorry!!!”

Britney claimed in a 2021 conservatorship hearing — her dad ran the guardianship for 13 years following her years of personal struggles — that none of her family members had interfered with Jamie’s alleged mismanagement of the conservatorship. Both Jamie, 74, and Lynne, 71,  have long denied Britney’s accusations, with the matriarch still hoping for future reconciliation.

items.summary:
Tennessee Titans defensive end Jaylen Harrell has been hospitalize d after a car crash.

“Yesterday, Jaylen Harrell was involved in a serious car accident that resulted in him being taken to the hospital in his hometown of Tampa, Florida,” a rep for the Titans told ESPN in a Saturday, November 21, statement. “We have been in constant communication with Jaylen’s family and are still working to gather more information.

The statement continued, “At this time, Jaylen remains in the hospital and continues to receive care. We ask that Jaylen and his family’s privacy be respected at this time. We will provide an update when appropriate.”

Harrell, 24, had been a passenger in an Uber rideshare at the time of the accident, ESPN reported. No further details have been publicly shared.

items.title: David Beckham's perfume, Poundland – and a mighty, mighty stink | Arwa Mahdawi
items.summary:
The Beckhams have made an art of monetising their every move. But apparently there are limits to where they’re prepared to sell their wares

Thoughts and half-price prayers with Poundland, please. The discount chain has been on the verge of collapse for a while, and its future looks bleak. Now, to add to the ignominy, David Beckham is kicking it while it’s down.

Not literally, by the way: I suppose I should spell that out since we’re dealing with a litigious billionaire. I did not mean to imply or cause a reasonable person to infer that Sir David is standing on Brixton high street kicking a Poundland. Rather, DB Ventures, the licensor of the David Beckham brand, is causing a bit of a stink about the fact that the football legend’s fragrance range was found on sale in the discount store as well as at other purveyors of budget goods. It is now suing the perfume company, Coty, which it further accuses of under reporting sales, for $41m (£31m).
